rows.info: Fingerprint or automatic login leaves your login keyring locked, so saving a key asks for its password. A private file needs no password: each secret is kept in its own file in your Fermix home, readable only by your account and not encrypted. Secrets you already saved stay where they are, and `fermix setup --migrate-secrets` moves them.

rows.info: How items are screened before the filter model reads them. Words: only an item containing one of the watcher's words gets through. A decision model checks each item by its meaning instead, with the watcher's purpose, instructions and words as hints, in about a third of a second, roughly ten times faster than a chat model.

rows.info: Judges each item on its own, so a smaller, faster model works well and costs much less than your main model.
